# ZH.WHO

> ZH.WHO is a Detroit motorcycle content creator. Street and strip riding, night runs, and rider culture.

Content reflects personal riding experience. Not a paid dealer or sponsor endorsement unless explicitly stated.

ZH.WHO is a member of The Moto Legion (https://themotolegion.com/), a southeast Michigan motorcycle content collective.

## About

- [Home](https://zhwho.com/): Central hub with the ZH.WHO identity, links to every platform, and quick access to support and partners

## Content types

- Street riding footage from Detroit and the surrounding metro
- Strip and drag runs
- Night rides and local meet coverage
- Rider culture, community moments, and street level storytelling

## Location

- Detroit, Michigan, United States

## Platforms

- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@zh.who): Short form ride and culture clips
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/zh.who/): Photos, reels, event clips
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@zhwho): Long form ride footage
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/fz67hjDnPW): Rider community server, shared with The Moto Legion
